items.title: Alvin Alcorn Interview, 1976-01-25
items.q: Buddy Bolden was before your time, right? ... So Buddy Bolden died, I was pretty young when he died

ctx.x: Yeah. I guess Buddy Bolden was before your time, right?
Oh, yeah. So Buddy Bolden died, I was pretty young when he died, because they brought him back here. My mother didn't know Buddy Bolden.
